div.head: Symposium the ‘Tribe’ in the WANA Region, 3rd & 4th of October 2024
div.p: On the 3rd and 4th of October 2024, an interdisciplinary symposium, led by our colleague Laura Stocker, will be held at the University of Vienna. Scholars from different disciplines, including history, (socio-)linguistics, and social anthropology, will critically examine the concept of ‘tribe’ and its various interpretations in different academic fields.

The symposium will be held in the lecture room of the Institute of Near Eastern Studies:
University of Vienna, Institute for Near Eastern Studies
Spitalgasse 2, Hof 4.1, A-1090 Vienna
For more information, please contact Laura Stocker via laura.stocker@univie.ac.at .
Participation is free of charge, but we kindly ask you to register in advance via philipp.marc.hessabi@univie.ac.at .
